name: Small inventory
description: The things you keep in stock, where each is kept, and every time some came in or went out.

item.description: Something you keep a stock of, like printer paper or jars of honey.

unit.description: what you count it in, like boxes or jars

reorderAt.label: Reorder at
reorderAt.description: restock when it gets down to this many

location.description: Somewhere things are kept: a shelf, a cupboard, a van.

movement.description: Some of an item coming in (a delivery) or going out (used or sold). Stock is what they add up to.

change.description: how many came in (positive) or went out (negative)

movement.label: {reason} {change}

add-item.title: Add an item
add-item.description: Start keeping track of something you stock, and when to reorder it.

add-item-here.title: Add an item kept here
add-item-here.description: Add an item that is kept in this location, by name, and when to reorder it.

receive.title: Some came in
receive.description: Record a delivery or restock: how many came in today.

use.title: Some went out
use.description: Record some of an item used or sold today: how many went out.

set-reorder-point.title: Set when to reorder
set-reorder-point.description: Say how low an item may get before it needs restocking.

store-in.title: Keep somewhere
store-in.description: Say where an item is kept, in place of wherever it was.
store-in.fromTheOtherEnd: Keep one of our items here

take-out-of-location.title: Take out of its location
take-out-of-location.description: Say an item is no longer kept where it was.
take-out-of-location.fromTheOtherEnd: Take an item out of here

add-movement.title: Record a movement
add-movement.description: Record stock coming in or going out, before saying which item it was.

attribute-movement.title: Say which item
attribute-movement.description: Say which item a movement was of.
attribute-movement.fromTheOtherEnd: Record a movement against this item

detach-movement.title: Take off its item
detach-movement.description: Take a movement off the item it was recorded against, so it no longer counts.
detach-movement.fromTheOtherEnd: Take a movement off this item

stock-above-reorder-point.title: Nothing runs below its reorder point
stock-above-reorder-point.description: The time to reorder is before the last box goes, not after.

stock-not-negative.title: Stock never goes below none
stock-not-negative.description: Using more than you had means a delivery or a count went unrecorded.
stock-not-negative.says: {name} shows {sum(in('of'), 'change')} in stock — a delivery or a count is missing

grants.describe: Owners and editors may do everything; viewers can look.
